unit: Geometry · Chapter VIII. Coordinates and vectors

stages.headline: Nonzero vectors are collinear if they lie on one line or on parallel lines; collinear vectors are codirectional or opposite.
stages.headlineEnglish: Nonzero vectors are collinear if they lie on one line or on parallel lines; collinear vectors are codirectional or opposite.

stages.headline: Vectors are equal if they are codirectional and equally long: in parallelogram ABCD, AB = DC and AD = BC as vectors.
stages.headlineEnglish: Vectors are equal if they are codirectional and equally long: in parallelogram ABCD, AB = DC and AD = BC as vectors.

stages.headline: Equal vectors are collinear; AB and BA are opposite vectors: equal lengths, opposite directions.
stages.headlineEnglish: Equal vectors are collinear; AB and BA are opposite vectors: equal lengths, opposite directions.
